items.prompt:
Read.

Fish returned after the plant stopped dumping waste.

We infer the dumping had:
A) helped the fish
B) harmed the fish
C) no effect

'Strong' textual evidence is the:
A) most convincing evidence
B) longest paragraph
C) first word

An inference is a conclusion drawn from:
A) evidence and reasoning
B) a guess
C) the title

Read.

After free clinics opened, uninsured ER visits fell 40%, vaccinations rose, and infant mortality dropped.

To show the clinics improved HEALTH, the strongest evidence is:
A) that clinics opened
B) infant mortality dropped and ER visits fell 40%
C) that they were free
items.answer: B) infant mortality dropped and ER visits fell 40%

steps: Direct health outcomes. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) infant mortality dropped and ER visits fell 40%

items.prompt:
Read.

The city added transit and car traffic fell 25%.

We infer transit:
A) increased driving
B) reduced driving
C) had no effect

'Strong AND thorough' evidence means:
A) the most convincing evidence, and enough of it
B) a single weak fact
C) unrelated facts
items.answer: A) the most convincing evidence, and enough of it

solution.answer: A) the most convincing evidence, and enough of it

items.prompt:

The mine's profits soared while it paid record fines for safety violations.

The strongest supported inference is that the mine:
A) was losing money
B) prioritized profit over worker safety
C) was very cautious
items.answer: B) prioritized profit over worker safety

steps: Profits up, safety fined. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) prioritized profit over worker safety
